title: The integration tier, and an engine-level member of the smoke profile, still use the machine's default network
foundBy: session agent, extending the SBX-087 fix to make test-integration
details: SBX-087 moved `make test-smoke` into a group of its own, but `make test-integration` still runs every live test in the default group. It makes and reuses the machine's default network and keepalive, as the smoke profile did before. The engine-level live tests build their own Deps with the network `cs-sandbox-net`, whatever group a target names. One of them, TestPodmanCreateLive, is a smoke member, so its container joins the default network even inside the smoke profile's own group.
